items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny Man, that name doesn’t ring a bell. That is the person that ever her the name, to my knowledge.

ctx.x: I have a Howard McGee date. Now, the Howard McGee date, I have was on a label called Parrot. Savoy bought that out. That is the date that that Billy Eckstein was on. Do you remember Kenny Man? Ray Brown and J.C. Herd were on that date.

Of course I remember Ray Brown and J.C. Herd. I don’t know if Kenny Man was on that date. I don't remember him. But, I don't remember that very first date. I'm trying to remember. It seems to me though, that the date you just mentioned, was that a Savoy date?
